_comment: The guard against the datagram fix becoming a weaker test.
Reading the kernel's violation count proves a refusal happened somewhere in the lease. It does
NOT prove that THIS datagram was the thing refused. Here the workload printed SENT - the send
succeeded - while the receipt still counts a violation, as it would if an unrelated exec or open
had been denied in the same lease.
udp_outside_the_lease_blocked must be false. If it is ever true for this fixture, the check has
stopped testing whether the datagram was refused and started testing whether anything was.
